mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher wage-driven consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing HOUST (housing starts) and decreasing RSAFS (retail sales) signals a shift in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors reassess economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in mid-cycle slowdowns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO (industrial production) above its 6-month moving average indicates strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher productivity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO is above its 6-month MA, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between decreasing FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL (inflation rate) signals a monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher inflation-adjusted interest rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in inflationary regimes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in PAYEMS (non-farm payroll employment) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher employment-driven economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with sustained PAYEMS growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of increasing GDPC1 and decreasing UNRATE signals a demand-driven economic boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in late-cycle booms are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).
